title: C2PO: Diagnosing and Disentangling Bias Shortcuts in LLMs
findings: The proposed C2PO method significantly reduces stereotypical biases, including those related to religion as measured by the BBQ and UnQover benchmarks. For instance, on the DeepSeek-R1 backbone, C2PO achieved near-perfect accuracy (99.9%) and minimal bias (0.2) on UnQover, demonstrating its ability to mitigate bias without degrading general model performance.
